name: not-found-page
title: Not found page
description: Black 404 page with a dotted status code, title, a did you mean suggestion, two outline pills, and index links.
usage: The site's 404. Pass the site's pages as `knownPaths` (most important first) and the closest one to the requested path is offered as "Did you mean" (findClosestPath catches typos and shorthands; the path is read from the address after mount unless `pathname` is given). Two `pill-on-brand` buttons as `actions` (the second with `border-white/40`), the index links as `note`, the white logo as `logo`. `overlay` covers the window above the site's header and footer, as the site does. DotNumber draws any number in the round dots.
avoid: The header and footer around it
A suggestion that pushes the page down when it appears

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
